links.comparator_used: Unprompted (naïve) ChatGPT-4.0 query with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease Score and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of responses to hamstring injury FAQs
links.effect: Unprompted: FRES 61.64, FKGL 10.28. Seventh-grade prompt: FRES 75.2, FKGL 6.1. College graduate prompt: FRES 12.08, FKGL 17.23.
links.tradeoff: Accuracy was graded only on the unprompted responses (2 of 10 grade A, 7 B, 1 C), so the effect of reading-level prompts on accuracy or completeness was not assessed.
links.quote: However, when explicitly prompted, ChatGPT reliably adjusted the complexity of its responses to both a seventh-grade and a graduate-level reading standard.
